reason: I drive down to Jbeil every Saturday and fill the boot, so I already get the carton prices myself and the trip costs me nothing extra. A daily service doesn't fit how I shop, and I'd rather see what I'm buying on the shelf.
objection: Sending a list before 2 p.m. every time is a hassle, and I'd be trusting strangers to pick my items and tell me honestly what they paid at the till. $2 a bag on a tight budget adds up for something I already do once a week.
would_change_my_mind: If I could see the actual till receipts and it saved me clearly more than the fee on my weekly list, and I could send one list for the week instead of every day, I might try it once when the car is off the road.
